notes.title: UPDATE 03/07: Optimizations
notes.content:
[h1]General optimizations and some QOL changes[/h1]

Hello people! Hope you are having a great summer. The weather here has been absolutely dreadful so I've had some time to implement some improvements for the game.

[h2]Patch notes:[/h2]

[list]
[*] Reduced texture sizes across the board, visual impact should be minimal. Due to this the game install size has been reduced by about 50%
[*] Loading times should be drastically improved for low spec machines.
[*] Asynchronous map loading between rounds
[*] Increased the server timeout delay which caused client disconnection between rounds in some scenarios
[*] Camera now follows a ragdolling player (only when knocked out)
[*] Reduced shader complexity for some materials
[/list]

That's it for this update.

Cheers.

notes.title: UPDATE 22/02
notes.content:
[h1]Hello people! [/h1]

Custom game settings have arrived along with some other gameplay improvements! 

[h2]Patch notes[/h2]

Password protected servers can now be created.  

Custom game settings

	• Health multiplier
	• Damage multiplier
	• Gravity multiplier
	• Movement speed multiplier
	• Headshots only
	• Remove default map items

Amount of items spawned can be edited. There is a hard cap of 200 per item which should be more than enough; Default settings have around 20-30 weapons spawning per match in addition to the default melee weapons found in maps which accounts to roughly 60-100 weapons per map. Maps also have roughly 100 alcoholic beverages spawned on average. Note that large amounts of items can affect server performance. Items have a cleanup lifecycle which respawns the item 20 seconds after the item has been interacted with. The list of spawnable items include [b]!!!EVERY ITEM IN THE GAME INCLUDING ZOMBIE SUPER WEAPONS!!![/b] The weapon arsenal is arguably quite a large so some UI updates might be coming in the future to better sort the stuff in the menu. 

Custom game settings are saved by pressing the save button. Creating a server which uses the custom settings also saves the settings. (Custom setting presets and save slots might be coming in the future!)

 Movement and combat improvements

	• You can now shoot and jump at the same time.
	• Weapons no longer trigger kick animation after the last shot has been fired
	• Separate kick button has been added (default key is V)
	• Aerial kicking now happens when pressing kick button while airborne
	• Aerial kicking can be canceled by releasing kick key while still airborne
	• Aerial kick damage is based on velocity 
	• Aerial kick no longer forces third person camera
	• Improved kicking animations
	• You can shoot while kicking [b](watch for your toes, it is possible to shoot yourself in the foot)[/b]
	• You can shoot while aerial kicking
	• Bots can kick too!

Crosshair has been uhm... [i]Re-centered[/i]. Instead of always going left it now travels all around the screen to better simulate inaccuracy caused by unhealthy amounts of alcohol consumption.

That's it for now, stay hydrated!

notes.title: Development update
notes.content:
[h1]Hello people.[/h1]

It's been a long and a very dark winter here but the sun is actually shining outside right now; mökkiseason is just around the corner. My job has taken pretty much all of my time and energy but I've managed to get some work done in the last couple of weeks. 

I've planned a QOL update for this month which enables custom game rules and password protected servers. You can edit the amount of weapons and beer spawned and tinker with some other settings which should spice up the gameplay a little bit. If you have any ideas for custom settings, post a comment here or on the discussion board. All ideas and feedback is appreciated.

Thanks for the support so far and cheers!

notes.title: CHRISTMAS UPDATE 19/12
notes.content:
[h1]Christmas update is here! [/h1]

Christmas is coming soon so it's the perfect time to practice your table manners in the new FFA_WinterRentalCabin map. The map has been inspired by the generic rental cabins every Finn has rented (and probably thrashed) at some point in their life. New winter weather scenarios are aimed to be realistic so the sun doesn't really rise above the horizon even during daytime. It's time to whip out your flashlights (default key is T)! 

As a reminder, the soundtrack has been uploaded to every major streaming service! You can now listen to evergreen hits such as "Rautamies" and "Satanic genocide pt. 2" while pumping iron at the gym, doing laundry or just existing!   

[previewyoutube=8e_RGKah1P8;leftthumb][/previewyoutube]

 [h2][/h2]
This will be the final update for this year apart from possible hotfix updates. 

[h3]Merry Christmas and happy New Year! [/h3]


[h2]New content[/h2]
[h3]New maps:[/h3]
[list]
[*] FFA_WinterRentalCabin
[*] 	NFD_WinterHell
[*] 	NFD_WinterFarm
[/list]
[h3]	Winter map variations[/h3]
[list]
[*] 	FFA_WinterCabin
[*] 	FFA_WinterHouse
[/list]
[h3]Other new content[/h3]
[list]
[*] 	New beverages
[*] 	New melee weapons
[*] 	New firearms
[*] 	New explosives
[*] 	Santa hat cosmetic
[*] 	Xmas sombrero cosmetic
[*] 	Added seasonal christmas trees to some levels
[/list]
[h2]New features[/h2]
[h3]Gameplay[/h3]
[list]
[*] 	You can now smoke cigarettes! G is the default key. Smoking provides no bonuses and is detrimental to your health. Just like in real life. 
[*] 	Some winter maps have freezing temperatures with preset warm areas. Stay inside these warm areas or risk freezing to death. 
[*] 	Doors are now snappier and should function better with bots
[*] You will now automatically spectate other players in zombie mode if you happen to die a horrible death
[/list]
[h3]Visuals[/h3]
[list]
[*] 	Landscape material tiling improvements
[*] 	Volumetric fog effects for all levels
[*] 	Disabled buggy global illumination (should lead to performance improvements across the board with improved visual clarity especially during nighttime)
[*] 	New winter weather scenarios
[/list]
[h2]Improvements to existing systems[/h2]
[list]
[*] 	New zombie maps have been added to leaderboards. 
[*] Improved zombie and player ragdolls
[/list]
[h3]Bugfixes[/h3]
[list]
[*] 	Purchasable ammo boxes should now use score points correctly
[*] 	Diabolical weapon dispensers should also use points correctly
[*] 	Bots should shoot straight with weapons now
[/list]

notes.title: Content update: RANKAISIJAT
notes.content:
[h1]The legendary warriors have arrived![/h1]

It's time for new playable characters! Zombie mode has also received some balancing changes. Zombies are a bit slower now but have more responsive pathfinding. There is also a 'little' surprise in there to shake some things up.



[h3]Additions:[/h3]

[list]
[*] Added two new playable characters
[*] Added new firearms
[*] New firearm SFX and VFX
[*] Leaderboards for zombies and beer drinking, will be reset periodically
[*] New melee weapons
[*] Mouse can be inverted
[/list]

[h3]Fixes:[/h3]

[list]
[*] Fatal error when changing a map
[*] Particle effects and SFX should replicate correctly with projectiles
[*] Weapons no more collide with players after dropping
[*] Bikes should not get stuck to players anymore
[*] Performance improvements across the board
[/list]

As a sidenote, if the server is feeling laggy chances are the host does not have a capable PC to run the game. Running the game with suboptimal PC might lead to unexpected behaviour for all connected clients. 

 I'll be monitoring the new patch and deploying hotfixes if necessary. Demo will also receive an update tomorrow.

Stay hydrated and have a nice weekend!

notes.title: Development progress
notes.content:
[h1]Hello people. [/h1]

The launch of the game has went surprisingly smoothly so far. Thanks for everyone who has played the game, I hope you had fun and stayed hydrated.

I've planned a new update for the next week featuring a legendary warrior from the Finnish folklore and also the first foreign fighter from our neighboring country. New characters need to be unlocked in a same way as the existing characters. Leaderboards will also be arriving in this update, displaying the top 100 players in every zombie map and also the top 100 beer drinkers. I'll be adding more stats after the initial update. 

Additionally, I went to a shooting range with my buddy and recorded some actual gunfire audio. There might be new weapons coming in the next patch along with audio and VFX updates to all existing weapons. 
[h3]
Cheers![/h3]

notes.title: UPDATE 31/10
notes.content:
[h1]Hello people. [/h1]

It seems that someone let some spurgu zombies loose near a military camp and the same individual seems to have forgotten that Finland has signed the Ottawa Treaty. Anyways there is a tent sauna and cold beer nearby so you should be fine.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45176404/aaac4b8941d55c27bff07168f8492bc7e4ca525d.png[/img]

[h2]Other additions: [/h2]
[list]
[*] Weather effects have now unique wind modifiers
[*] Ambient sounds should loop a bit better now
[*] Added in game text chat to the game
[*] Server owner can now kick people using !kick command
[/list]

There is also a [b]non-functional button for leaderboards[/b] in the main menu, this is planned to be released at a later date. Planned statistics include at least zombie mode highscores and idk maybe the amount of consumed beer during a match, haven't given too much thought to that subject yet.  Survived zombie mode wave highscores are tracked to your save file now so you can rest easy that your data is totally safe on your computer and ready to be synced when the leaderboards arrive. 

[h2]Unlocking characters[/h2]
There has been some confusion about how to unlock characters and that is totally on me, I forgot to add hints to just about every challenge. Lets just say that Finns love to go to sauna, fish and some like suicidal sports like extreme bike riding. The black metal dude likes Satan. 

Anyways.

[h3]Have a nice weekend![/h3]
